# Carl

## Overview

- **Age:** nine  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE P22](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0022)</sub>
- **Family:** [Cecilia Meredith](../character/cecilia-meredith.md) (parent), [Faith](../character/faith.md) (sibling), [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) (parent), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Carl possesses clear, bright, dark-blue eyes that are direct and fearless. He also has brown hair featuring glints of gold.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

Carl possesses a strong passion for nature and small creatures, frequently collecting toads, bugs, frogs, ants, and spiders. Driven by a desire to explore African jungles when he grows up, he is nevertheless spooked by the tale of Henry Warren's ghost.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER XXVI. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE P0](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0000)_

## History

Carl lived in [Maywater](../codex/places.md#maywater) before moving to the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with his family. After meeting the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), Carl and his siblings quickly bonded with them and formed a close friendship. He later joined his siblings and the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) in forming the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) to manage their behavior and impose self-punishments to protect their father's reputation. As part of a club punishment, Carl mistook a local woman under a sheet for a ghost while in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), resulting in a mortifying flight to safety. Jerry then ordered Carl to sit alone in the graveyard until midnight as a penalty for cowardice; Carl completed the task during a chilling rainstorm, which caused him to contract a severe case of pneumonia that he narrowly survived under Dr. Blythe's care. Following his recovery, Carl put an eel in Mrs. Carr's buggy, but when his father attempted to whip him as punishment, his father broke down upon looking into Carl's eyes and spared him.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. ### [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carl--john-meredith.md)

Carl is the son of [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), the local minister who frequently gets distracted by his theological studies. When Carl plays a prank by placing an eel in Mrs. Carr's buggy, his father intends to whip him as punishment, but breaks down and refuses to carry it out after looking into Carl's eyes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P85](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P0](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P15](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0015), +15 more_

### [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carl--mary-vance.md)

Carl is a friend of [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), a runaway orphan whom Carl and his siblings discover hiding in a barn loft and help shelter. Their friendship includes shared moments such as observing ants together in the graveyard and spending time with the group in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).
